title: Abstract generative pattern
description: A generation-oriented abstraction of a style track's behaviour over one bar/section. Never raw notes: chord/scale degrees, rhythmic grid, contour, density.

abstract_representation.description: Only fields relevant to the role are present.

rhythm_cell_16.description: Active onset slots on a 1/16 grid, one bar (4/4).

syncopation.description: Fraction of onsets off the quarter-note beats.

degrees.description: Chord/scale degrees relative to the source root C (1, b3, 5, b7, ...).

avg_voices.description: CHORD_COMP: mean simultaneous notes = voicing width.

mutation_axes.description: Parameters a generator may safely vary (octave, syncopation, ghost_density, voicing_width, ...).
